Horus Heresy Forces of the Machine God
These rules can only be used in conjunction with the Adeptus Mechanicus Codex.

Designer's note: While the focus of Custom40k lies on the actual Warhammer 40.000 setting, it has room to bring 30k armies to the table as well. Keep in mind though, that this part is not actively developed, unless units get specifically requested. This is a supplement that needs to be used together with Codex Adeptus Mechanicus.
